## Scope

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Identify the affected Node, Hub,
Control or protocol boundary and any compatibility or migration implications.

## Validation

Record checks actually run, tested source/artifact identity and material limits.
Keep failures, skips and unknowns visible; distinguish deterministic/disposable
checks from native Runtime, Android, physical-device and public HTTPS evidence.

## Contracts and documentation

Link relevant contract and documentation updates, or explain why none are needed.
Use synthetic examples and sanitized evidence; exclude credentials, private keys,
grants, private host paths and full sensitive payloads.
